common_intervals: all hybrid.eligible_spans of length >=128; no play/label-density filter
interval_encoding: JSONL [snapshot_clip_index, [[start,stop_exclusive],...]]; never merge adjacent PTS-separated intervals

training.accept: at least one known teacher in the shared 128-frame pack; min observed=0
training.child_starts: pack_start + j*T, j=0..128/T-1; no child-level rejection
training.sampling: uniform over accepted train packs, with replacement; same seeded pack stream for all T/models
training.update: one shared pack for F=128, q packs for F=128*q; every child is forwarded
training.zero_teacher_child: zero contribution, normalized by the whole update's known teacher count
training.absence_mixture: natural frequency within common packs; no additional absence sampler

evaluation.tail: append stop-T once; no padding or cropping
evaluation.score: all labeled frames once, never gate observed
evaluation.absence: kind-specific FPR within common confirmed negatives; FNR on common observed

historical_evidence.purpose: rejected separate-set proposal; audit equality with common confirmed negatives; exclusive support is 0
